results.title: China’s neighborhood ties mix disputes with deep economic links.
results.description: China’s neighborhood ties mix disputes with deep economic links. ASEAN is its top trading partner (over $1T). Vietnam expands party and rail cooperation despite South China Sea frictions. South Korea’s relations are warming with high-level visits and strong trade. Japan remains a major partner amid Taiwan tensions. India engages via BRICS while border talks continue. Russia is a close strategic partner; North Korea a traditional ally. Relations are pragmatic, not uniform hostility.
